title: Twi Translation Benchmark Lab — Development Sample Dataset
description: Original English passage fixtures for evaluating English-to-Asante Twi translation engines on children's story content. Covers 16 linguistic categories across 8 mini-stories.
notes: Development fixture only. All passages are original compositions and are NOT a validated or representative linguistic benchmark. No Asante Twi reference translations have been provided; all reference_status values are 'absent'. Qualified Asante Twi reviewers must supply and approve references before these passages can be used as ground truth. Five multi-passage stories (STORY-001 through STORY-002, STORY-005 through STORY-008) allow Phase 3 experiments to test narrative consistency across passages within a single story. Category distribution is intentional but not exhaustive; additional passages should be added before any comparative study is published.
